# AstralyxPvP

> AstralyxPvP is a free India-based Java 1.9+ FFA Minecraft PvP server with custom skill-based ELO, live leaderboards, vote keys, PvP bots, and an active Discord community. Join on `play.astralyxpvp.org`.

## Server Info
- Java IP: play.astralyxpvp.org
- Versions: Minecraft Java 1.9 and above
- Region: India-based, with the main server infrastructure in Europe. Dynamically selected proxies route traffic from our IP for low-latency pings in both India and Europe.
- Founded: April 2026
- Access: Free — cracked/offline mode clients supported
- Discord: https://discord.gg/u8BFrpRwEg

## How to Join
1. Click the Join Server button on the website, or copy the address below.
2. Java: `play.astralyxpvp.org` — add it in Minecraft → Multiplayer → Add Server.
3. Paste the address and click Join.

## ELO & Leaderboard
Every kill and death in FFA and 1v1 arenas updates your rating through the custom plugin. See the live leaderboard at https://astralyxpvp.org/leaderboard

## Game Modes
- SWORDFFA (sword FFA arena)
- 1v1 arenas
- PvP bots in supported arenas, including Crystal PvP
- Vote keys and cosmetics

## Legacy Addresses
`java.astralyxpvp.int.yt`, `none-subscribe.gl.joinmc.link`, and `stammer-affilated.tun.ply.gg` all belonged to AstralyxPvP. They were addresses for older AstralyxPvP servers and are now deprecated, so they will be shut down. Always use the official address above.
